Quests.Title: An extremely extremely extremely extremely extremely extremely long quest title used to verify the long-text preview
Quests.Description: This quest description is deliberately very very long: it verifies that long text renders as a two-line truncated preview, expands into a full textarea on click, collapses back on blur, the source column also expands for side-by-side comparison, and the save button stays vertically centered and aligned with the actions header throughout this whole interaction.
